goals: Maintain the progression-gated one-way return system for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric using one shared placed Dragonbound Waystone, an Imbued Void Pearl, and a cooldown-based Dragonbound Staff.

Preserve the accepted server-owned channel, exact-destination safety, persistent anchor, loss protection, recipes, configuration migration, discovery behavior, geometry, and art while allowing one eligible building block identity to select the Waystone's visual material without expanding into a general waypoint or teleport system.
scope: Canary 13 succeeds the accepted Canary 12 with one persistent block-id material component, a two-input dynamic crafting recipe, and a client-only baked-model wrapper that retains the accepted four-cuboid Waystone geometry and UVs while substituting safe default-state directional donor sprites.

Preserve the 40-tick default channel, 1,200-tick Staff cooldown, existing primary recipes plus the dynamic material recipe, one-click and mouse-release-independent channel lifecycle, exact arrival at the visible Waystone top, recipe-book and JEI discovery seam, and success-only consumption and cooldown behavior.
Retain exact accepted Canary 5 and focused-runtime-passed Canary 4 rollback artifacts together with the Dragonbound-owned Staff art and the separately licensed Matcha Stable Void snapshot and notice.

exclusions: Multiple destinations, waypoint lists, portals, home commands, arbitrary coordinates, nearby-position fallback, XP costs, durability, charges, pet or group teleport, and other feature or balance changes.

Changes to Waystone collision/shape, teleport and anchor authority, channel timing, Staff/Pearl behavior, loss protection, existing primary recipes, dependencies, configuration, particles/sounds, art, or unrelated scope beyond the Canary 13 visual-material component and recipe.
Mod Menu polish and dedicated-server validation remain deferred; the accepted evidence is the recorded client and singleplayer scope only.
Other projects and their source, status, artifacts, dependencies, and ownership records remain outside this project.

Minecraft deployment, either experimental Test Slot, accepted physical-baseline changes, Test Instance Manager mutation, Minecraft launch, and protected gameplay-instance access during this migration.
Redistribution of the embedded Matcha/Klei bitmap without independently satisfying its CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 attribution, non-commercial, and share-alike terms.
